what: a rib drawn on a plane 20 mm in front of a block (parallel to XZ, a 40 mm line along X) with direction normal, growing toward the block
method: the wall runs along the sketch normal (+Y) from y = -20 to the block face y = 0 and into it, 40 long and 2 thick (across the curve, in the sketch plane): it adds 40 * 2 * 20 = 1600 to the block 60 x 40 x 10: V = 24000 + 1600 = 25600, one body.
